unitTitle: Present Perfect - Past Simple - Ever/Never - Just - Yet/Already - For/Since
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 64-BET. Unit 15 nazariyasi — Present Perfect (mashqsiz bet).

Skaner bilan solishtirildi. Ikkala jadval (to'g'ri fe'l 'work' va noto'g'ri fe'l 'buy') hamda Form/Use qoidalari to'g'ri ko'chirilgan.

⚠ JADVALLARNING MAQSADI: ikkalasi bir xil ko'rinadi va bu ATAYLAB. Yagona farq — uchinchi shakl:
  to'g'ri fe'l:   work → worked → WORKED   (II va III shakl BIR XIL)
  noto'g'ri fe'l: buy  → bought → BOUGHT   (yodlanadi)
  ⚠ Qolgan hamma narsa — have/has, savol tartibi, inkor — ikkalasida bir xil.

⚠ HALOL QAYD: jadvallarga biz qisqacha xulosa qatorini qo'shdik ('work → worked → worked (regular verb: V2 = V3)'). Bu KITOBDA YO'Q — jadvalning mohiyatini bir qatorda ko'rsatish uchun qo'shilgan. Qolgan hamma qator kitobdan aynan olingan.

⚠ PRESENT PERFECT NIMA UChUN KERAK — IKKI HOLAT:
  1) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN o'tgan ish:
     'He HAS WASHED the car.' — qachon yuvgani MUHIM EMAS.
     ⚠ Agar vaqt aytilsa ('yesterday'), Past Simple bo'ladi.
  2) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB, HOZIR HAM DAVOM etayotgan ish:
     'I HAVE KNOWN Tom for 5 years.' — hamon tanish.
     ⚠ O'zbekchada bu 'besh yildan beri bilaman' — HOZIRGI zamon bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun bu joy qiyin.

⚠ VAQT RAVIShLARI: since, for, just, already, yet, never, ever — bularning bittasi gapda bo'lsa, deyarli har doim Present Perfect kerak. Bu — eng ishonchli belgi.

⚠ 'HE'S' IKKI MA'NOLI: 'he's worked' = he HAS worked (Present Perfect); 'he's working' = he IS working (davomli zamon). Qisqartma bir xil, lekin keyingi so'zning shakli farqni ko'rsatadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI FE'L: work → worked → WORKED
(V2 va V3 BIR XIL)


TASDIQ (Affirmative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL          QISQA SHAKL
  I have worked         I'VE worked
  you have worked       YOU'VE worked
  he has worked         HE'S worked
  she has worked        SHE'S worked
  it has worked         IT'S worked
  we have worked        WE'VE worked
  you have worked       YOU'VE worked
  they have worked      THEY'VE worked


SO'ROQ (Interrogative):

  Have I worked?        Have we worked?
  Have you worked?      Have you worked?
  Has he worked?        Have they worked?
  Has she worked?
  Has it worked?


INKOR (Negative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL              QISQA SHAKL
  I have not worked         I HAVEN'T worked
  you have not worked       you HAVEN'T worked
  he has not worked         he HASN'T worked
  she has not worked        she HASN'T worked
  it has not worked         it HASN'T worked
  we have not worked        we HAVEN'T worked
  you have not worked       you HAVEN'T worked
  they have not worked      they HAVEN'T worked


OLTIN QOIDA:
  HAS  →  faqat HE / SHE / IT
  HAVE →  I / YOU / WE / THEY


QISQARTMALAR:
  have  →  'VE      (I've, you've, we've,
                     they've)
  has   →  'S       (he's, she's, it's)
  have not → HAVEN'T
  has not  → HASN'T


⚠ DIQQAT — 'HE'S' UCh MA'NOLI:
  'HE'S worked.'   =  he HAS worked
  'HE'S a doctor.' =  he IS a doctor
  'HE'S working.'  =  he IS working

  Qaysi ekanini KEYINGI SO'Z aytadi:
     keyin V3 kelsa     →  HAS
     keyin ot/sifat     →  IS
     keyin V-ing kelsa  →  IS

  Shu kabi 'IT'S' va 'SHE'S'.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQDA 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
  'Have you worked?'      ✓
  'DO you have worked?'   ✗


DIQQAT — INKORDA 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS:
  'I haven't worked.'     ✓
  'I DON'T have worked.'  ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a regular verb = to'g'ri fe'l
  affirmative    = tasdiq
  interrogative  = so'roq
  negative       = inkor
  long form      = to'liq shakl
  short form     = qisqa shakl

points.en: AFFIRMATIVE: I have worked / I've worked  •  he has worked / he's worked  •  they have worked / they've worked
points.uz: TASDIQ: men ishlaganman / u ishlagan / ular ishlashgan

points.en: INTERROGATIVE: Have I worked? Has he worked? Have they worked?
points.uz: SO'ROQ: Men ishlaganmanmi? U ishlaganmi? Ular ishlashganmi?
points.noteUz:
have/has EGADAN OLDIN turadi.
'DO you have worked?' — XATO.

points.en: NEGATIVE: I have not worked / I haven't worked  •  he has not worked / he hasn't worked
points.noteUz:
'not' — have/has va V3 ORASIDA.
Qisqartmalari: HAVEN'T, HASN'T.

points.en: work → worked → worked  (regular verb: V2 = V3)
points.uz: work → worked → worked (to'g'ri fe'l: II va III shakl bir xil)
points.noteUz: To'g'ri fe'llarda V3 = V2 = fe'l + ED.

exercises.explanationUz:
NOTO'G'RI FE'L: buy → bought → BOUGHT
(bu fe'lda V2 va V3 bir xil, lekin
boshqalarida boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin)


TASDIQ (Affirmative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL          QISQA SHAKL
  I have bought         I'VE bought
  you have bought       YOU'VE bought
  he has bought         HE'S bought
  she has bought        SHE'S bought
  it has bought         IT'S bought
  we have bought        WE'VE bought
  you have bought       YOU'VE bought
  they have bought      THEY'VE bought


SO'ROQ (Interrogative):

  Have I bought?        Have we bought?
  Have you bought?      Have you bought?
  Has he bought?        Have they bought?
  Has she bought?
  Has it bought?


INKOR (Negative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL              QISQA SHAKL
  I have not bought         I HAVEN'T bought
  he has not bought         he HASN'T bought
  they have not bought      they HAVEN'T bought
  ...


⚠ ENG MUHIM XULOSA:
  TUZILISH IKKALASIDA HAM BIR XIL!

  Faqat FE'LNING III ShAKLI farq qiladi:
     TO'G'RI:   work  →  WORKED
     NOTO'G'RI: buy   →  BOUGHT

  Qolgan hamma narsa (have/has, so'roq,
  inkor, qisqartma) AYNAN bir xil.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR — UCh TUR:

  1) UChALASI HAM BOShQA (ABC):
     see    → saw    → SEEN
     go     → went   → GONE
     eat    → ate    → EATEN
     drive  → drove  → DRIVEN
     ride   → rode   → RIDDEN
     fly    → flew   → FLOWN
     do     → did    → DONE
     be     → was/were → BEEN

  2) V2 va V3 BIR XIL (ABB):
     buy    → bought → BOUGHT
     meet   → met    → MET
     find   → found  → FOUND
     have   → had    → HAD
     make   → made   → MADE
     say    → said   → SAID

  3) UChALASI HAM BIR XIL (AAA):
     cut    → cut    → CUT
     put    → put    → PUT
     let    → let    → LET
     read   → read   → READ
            (yozilishi bir xil, O'QILIShI
             boshqa: /riːd/ → /red/)


DIQQAT — RO'YXAT KITOB OXIRIDA:
  Kitob aytadi: 'See list of irregular verbs
  at the end of the book.'

  Noto'g'ri fe'llar YODLANADI — qoida yo'q.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an irregular verb = noto'g'ri fe'l
  to buy = sotib olmoq (buy → BOUGHT)

points.en: AFFIRMATIVE: I have bought / I've bought  •  he has bought / he's bought
points.uz: TASDIQ: men sotib olganman / u sotib olgan
points.noteUz:
Tuzilish to'g'ri fe'l bilan AYNAN bir xil —
faqat V3 boshqa.

points.en: INTERROGATIVE: Have I bought? Has he bought? Have they bought?
points.uz: SO'ROQ: Sotib olganmanmi? U sotib olganmi?

points.en: NEGATIVE: I have not bought / I haven't bought  •  he has not bought / he hasn't bought
points.uz: INKOR: men sotib olmaganman / u sotib olmagan

points.noteUz:
Noto'g'ri fe'llarda V3 turlicha yasaladi —
YODLANADI.
Ro'yxat kitobning oxirida.

exercises.explanationUz:
YASALIShI (FORM) — KITOBDAGI BESh QOIDA:

 1 'We form the present perfect with the
    AUXILIARY VERB have/has and the PAST
    PARTICIPLE of the main verb.'
      I HAVE BOUGHT a new dress.

 2 'We form the past participle of REGULAR
    verbs by adding -ED to the verb.'
      watch - watchED
      bury - burIED

 3 'We form the past participle of IRREGULAR
    verbs DIFFERENTLY.'
      buy - BOUGHT

 4 'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting
    have/has BEFORE THE SUBJECT PRONOUN.'
      HAS HE washed the car?
      HAVE THEY travelled by plane?

 5 'We form the NEGATIVE by putting NOT
    BETWEEN have/has and the past participle.'
      He HAS NOT / HASN'T washed the car.
      They HAVE NOT / HAVEN'T travelled by
      plane.


'-ED' QO'ShISh QOIDALARI (2-band):

  Oddiy:            watch  →  watchED
  Oxiri 'E':        live   →  livED
                    (faqat -D)
  Oxiri UNDOSh+Y:   bury   →  burIED
                    study  →  studIED
                    (y → I + ED)
  Oxiri UNLI+Y:     play   →  playED
                    (y O'ZGARMAYDI!)
  Bir bo'g'in,
  unli+undosh:      stop   →  stopPED
                    (undosh IKKILANADI)

  Kitob ataylab 'bury - buried' misolini
  bergan — 'y' o'zgarishini ko'rsatish uchun.


IShLATILIShI (USE) — KITOBDAGI IKKI QOIDA:

 ⚠ 1) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN harakat:
    'We use the present perfect for actions
     which happened at an UNSTATED TIME in the
     past. The exact time is NOT IMPORTANT.'

      He HAS WASHED the car.
      (When did he wash it? WE DON'T KNOW
       when; the time is NOT MENTIONED.)

    Bu — Coursebook 106-betda o'rganilgan
    qoida.


 ⚠ 2) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB, HOZIR HAM DAVOM
    ETAYOTGAN harakat:
    'We ALSO use the present perfect for
     actions which STARTED IN THE PAST and are
     STILL CONTINUING IN THE PRESENT.'

      I HAVE KNOWN Tom for 5 years.
      (5 yil oldin tanishganman va HOZIR HAM
       tanishman.)

    ⚠ BU YANGI QOIDA — Coursebook'da
    to'liq berilmagan!


IKKI QO'LLANIShNI SOLIShTIRING:

  1) 'He has washed the car.'
     → ish TUGAGAN, lekin qachonligi noma'lum
     → natijasi HOZIR ko'rinadi (mashina toza)

  2) 'I have known Tom for 5 years.'
     → ish HALI DAVOM etyapti
     → 5 yil oldin boshlangan, hozir ham
       davom etadi

  Ikkinchi qo'llanishda odatda FOR yoki
  SINCE bo'ladi:
     'I've lived here FOR ten years.'
     'She's worked here SINCE 2010.'


⚠ O'ZBEK TILIDA FARQ:
  'I have known Tom for 5 years.'
  O'zbekchada: 'Tomni 5 yildan beri
  BILAMAN' (hozirgi zamon!)

  Ingliz tilida esa PRESENT PERFECT.
  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan joy,
  shuning uchun ko'p xato qilinadi:
     'I know Tom for 5 years.'      ✗
     'I have known Tom for 5 years.' ✓


VAQT RAVIShLARI (kitobdan):
  'Time adverbs used with the present
   perfect: SINCE, FOR, JUST, ALREADY, YET,
   NEVER, EVER.'

  Yetti so'z — hammasi Coursebook 106-107
  betlarida o'rganilgan.


DIQQAT — 'AUXILIARY VERB':
  'auxiliary verb' = yordamchi fe'l
  ('have/has' bu yerda o'z ma'nosini
   yo'qotgan — faqat zamon yasaydi)

  Solishtiring:
     'I HAVE a car.'      — asosiy fe'l
                            (menda mashina bor)
     'I HAVE bought a car.' — yordamchi fe'l


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an auxiliary verb = yordamchi fe'l
  a past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  a subject pronoun = ega olmoshi
  unstated          = aytilmagan
  exact             = aniq
  to mention        = tilga olmoq
  to continue       = davom etmoq
  to bury           = ko'mmoq
  to wash           = yuvmoq

points.en: We form the present perfect with the auxiliary verb have/has and the past participle of the main verb.  —  I have bought a new dress.
points.uz: Present Perfect ni yordamchi fe'l have/has va asosiy fe'lning III shakli bilan yasaymiz. — Yangi ko'ylak sotib oldim.
points.noteUz:
'auxiliary verb' = yordamchi fe'l.
Bu yerda 'have' o'z ma'nosini yo'qotgan —
faqat zamon yasaydi.

points.en: We form the past participle of regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb.  —  watch - watched, bury - buried
points.uz: To'g'ri fe'llarning III shaklini fe'lga -ED qo'shib yasaymiz. — watch-watched, bury-buried
points.noteUz:
DIQQAT — 'bury → burIED':
undoshdan keyingi 'Y' → I + ED.
Lekin unlidan keyin o'zgarmaydi:
'play → playED'.

points.en: We form the past participle of irregular verbs differently. (See list of irregular verbs at the end of the book.)  —  buy - bought
points.uz: Noto'g'ri fe'llarning III shaklini boshqacha yasaymiz. (Ro'yxat kitob oxirida.) — buy-bought

points.en: We form the interrogative by putting have/has before the subject pronoun.  —  Has he washed the car? Have they travelled by plane?
points.uz: So'roq shaklini have/has ni ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. — U mashinani yuvganmi? Ular samolyotda uchishganmi?

points.en: We form the negative by putting not between have/has and the past participle.  —  He hasn't washed the car.
points.uz: Inkor shaklini have/has va III shakl orasiga 'not' qo'yib yasaymiz. — U mashinani yuvmagan.

points.en: We use the present perfect for actions which happened at an unstated time in the past. The exact time is not important.  —  He has washed the car. (When did he wash it? We don't know when; the time is not mentioned.)
points.uz: Present Perfect ni o'tmishda VAQTI AYTILMAGAN holda sodir bo'lgan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Aniq vaqt muhim emas. — U mashinani yuvgan. (Qachon yuvgani noma'lum.)

points.en: We also use the present perfect for actions which started in the past and are still continuing in the present.  —  I have known Tom for 5 years.
points.uz: Present Perfect ni o'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun ham ishlatamiz. — Tomni 5 yildan beri bilaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 2-QO'LLANISH — YANGI QOIDA!
Coursebook'da to'liq berilmagan.

O'ZBEK TILIDAN FARQI: o'zbekchada HOZIRGI
zamon ('bilaman'), inglizchada PRESENT
PERFECT.
'I KNOW Tom for 5 years' — XATO!

points.en: Time adverbs used with the present perfect: since, for, just, already, yet, never, ever.
points.uz: Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ravishlari: since, for, just, already, yet, never, ever.
points.noteUz:
Yetti so'z — hammasi Coursebook 106-107
betlarida o'rganilgan.
